sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com进行部分采访的直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, a grand jury in Kentucky, weighing evidence in one of the country's most contentious police shootings,
sentences.zh: 今天，肯塔基州的一个大陪审团在权衡了该国最具争议的警察枪击案之一的证据后，

sentences.en: declined to bring charges against the two officers who shot Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 决定不对枪杀布伦娜·泰勒的两名警官提起指控。

sentences.en: My colleague,
sentences.zh: 我的同事，

sentences.en: Rukmini Kalamaki, is in Louisville.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼·卡拉马基，目前正在路易斯维尔。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月24日，星期四。

sentences.en: Rukmini, it's about 1230 in the morning on Thursday, and we're really grateful that we're able to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，现在是周四凌晨12点30分，非常感谢你能接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: And I guess just to start with, where are you this morning?
sentences.zh: 我想先问一下，你今天早上在哪里？

sentences.en: I'm in Louisville in an Airbnb where I'm staying.
sentences.zh: 我住在路易斯维尔的一家爱彼迎民宿里。

sentences.en: And how long have you been in Louisville?
sentences.zh: 你在路易斯维尔待了多久了？

sentences.en: I got here on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我是周一到的。

sentences.en: We heard last week that the Attorney General of Kentucky was going to announce whether the three officers who killed Breonna Taylor on the night of March 13th,
sentences.zh: 我们上周听说肯塔基州总检察长将宣布是否会对3月13日晚杀害布伦娜·泰勒的三名警官，

sentences.en: whether or not they were going to be charged.
sentences.zh: 是否会对他们提起指控。

sentences.en: There was a lot of anticipation over this announcement.
sentences.zh: 人们对这一宣布充满了期待。

sentences.en: Last week, Breonna Taylor's mother received a near record settlement of $12 million for the death of her daughter, and a number of police reforms were announced by the city.
sentences.zh: 上周，布伦娜·泰勒的母亲因女儿的死亡获得了近1200万美元的创纪录和解金，市政府也宣布了一系列警察改革措施。

sentences.en: But her mother and her relatives and advocates for Breonna Taylor have made it very clear that nothing short of charging all
sentences.zh: 但她的母亲、亲属以及布伦娜·泰勒的支持者们明确表示，如果不以谋杀罪起诉所有

sentences.en: three officers who killed her with murder would amount to justice.
sentences.zh: 三名杀害她的警官，就谈不上正义。

sentences.en: Now, I've spent the last couple of days speaking to legal experts about this case, and the people that I spoke to said very clearly that
sentences.zh: 过去几天我一直在与法律专家讨论这个案件，我采访的人非常明确地表示，

sentences.en: they thought that the Attorney General was essentially between a rock and a hard place.
sentences.zh: 他们认为总检察长基本上处于进退两难的境地。

sentences.en: They said that because of the fact that when the officers entered Breonna Taylor's home,
sentences.zh: 他们说，这是因为当警官进入布伦娜·泰勒家中时，

sentences.en: her boyfriend, Kenny Walker, who mistook the police for an intruder, opened fire and shot one of the police
sentences.zh: 她的男友肯尼·沃克误将警察当作入侵者并开枪击中了一名警察，

sentences.en: officers, because of that dynamic, the fact that the officers shot back and ultimately killed her would be protected under Kentucky's self-defense statute.
sentences.zh: 正是因为这种动态，警官随后还击并最终导致她死亡的行为，在肯塔基州的自卫法下会受到保护。

sentences.en: So here you have Breonna Taylor's mother saying nothing short of an indictment of these three police officers involved in the raid that killed her daughter would represent justice.
sentences.zh: 所以，布伦娜·泰勒的母亲说，如果不以谋杀罪起诉参与那次突袭并杀害她女儿的三名警官，就无法伸张正义。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, you have all these legal experts saying that is extremely unlikely because of the sequence of
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，所有这些法律专家都说，由于事件发生的顺序

sentences.en: events that happened and the state law governing police and self-defense.
sentences.zh: 以及州政府关于警察和自卫的法律，这种情况极不可能发生。

sentences.en: That's exactly it.
sentences.zh: 事实正是如此。

sentences.en: And Breonna's family wasn't just saying that they should be indicted.
sentences.zh: 而且布伦娜的家人不仅仅是说他们应该被起诉。

sentences.en: They were saying that they should be indicted for murder, for manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们应该因谋杀罪、过失杀人罪被起诉。

sentences.en: So on Monday, we knew that the grand jury began meeting.
sentences.zh: 所以周一我们知道大陪审团开始开会了。

sentences.en: We had sources who confirmed that to us.
sentences.zh: 我们有消息来源向我们证实了这一点。

sentences.en: We knew that they kept on deliberating on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们周二一直在审议。

sentences.en: And by Tuesday night, we were expecting an announcement.
sentences.zh: 到周二晚上，我们预计会有宣布。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, all over the city, there were signs of preparation for a clash.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，整个城市到处都有冲突准备的迹象。

sentences.en: The mayor's office issued an announcement that a state of emergency had been declared.
sentences.zh: 市长办公室发布公告称已宣布进入紧急状态。

sentences.en: The police department announced that vacation days were going to be canceled.
sentences.zh: 警察局宣布取消休假。

sentences.en: No police officers were going to be given off days.
sentences.zh: 所有警察都不得休息。

sentences.en: We started hearing that the National Guard might be called in, that the Kentucky State
sentences.zh: 我们开始听说国民警卫队可能会被召集，肯塔基州

sentences.en: Police were sending officers here.
sentences.zh: 警方正在向这里派遣警力。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, an ever-growing cordon was created around the city square that had been the nucleus of these protests, which have been going on now in the city nearly
sentences.zh: 与此同时，城市广场周围建立了一个不断扩大的警戒线，这里一直是这些抗议活动的中心，抗议活动在城里已经持续了

sentences.en: every night for more than a hundred days.
sentences.zh: 一百多天，几乎每晚都在进行。

sentences.en: They put up concrete barriers.
sentences.zh: 他们竖起了混凝土路障。

sentences.en: They brought in big dump trucks that blocked off the streets.
sentences.zh: 他们开来了大型自卸卡车封锁了街道。

sentences.en: Chain link fences were put around the area, making it impossible to drive there.
sentences.zh: 该区域周围安装了铁丝网围栏，导致车辆无法通行。

sentences.en: On top of that, federal court announced last week that they were closing.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，联邦法院上周宣布关闭。

sentences.en: Then just before the announcement, we heard that all of the other courts, family court, district court, all of these other courts also announced that they were closing.
sentences.zh: 就在宣布之前，我们听说所有其他法院，包括家庭法院、地方法院，所有这些法院也都宣布关闭。

sentences.en: It sounds like everyone in town seems to recognize what is about to happen, and everyone is on guard for it.
sentences.zh: 听起来城里的每个人似乎都知道即将发生什么，并且都在为此保持警惕。

sentences.en: Especially downtown.
sentences.zh: 特别是在市中心。

sentences.en: The Hyatt is boarded up, the Marriott is boarded up, business after business, government office after government office, in the
sentences.zh: 凯悦酒店被木板封住了，万豪酒店也被封住了，一家又一家企业，一个又一个政府办公室，在

sentences.en: downtown corridor, which is where the heart of these protests have been happening.
sentences.zh: 市中心走廊，也就是这些抗议活动发生的核心地带。

sentences.en: And I think that's a reflection of the fact that more and more protesters were showing up in the square with weapons.
sentences.zh: 我认为这反映了一个事实，即越来越多的抗议者带着武器出现在广场上。

sentences.en: This is an open carry state, so it's completely legal to do that.
sentences.zh: 这是一个允许公开携带武器的州，所以这样做是完全合法的。

sentences.en: But there was an ever-growing sense that we were heading towards some sort of clash, and that that clash could be violent.
sentences.zh: 但人们越来越感觉到我们正走向某种冲突，而且这种冲突可能是暴力的。

sentences.en: So what happens earlier today, on Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 那么今天早些时候，也就是周三，发生了什么？

sentences.en: As soon as I woke up on Wednesday morning, I had a text message from one of my good sources, an official who's helped me understand this investigation.
sentences.zh: 周三早上我一醒来，就收到了一条来自我可靠消息来源的短信，那是一位帮助我了解这项调查的官员。

sentences.en: And he said cryptically, it's beautiful weather for breaking news, be ready.
sentences.zh: 他隐晦地说，这是发布突发新闻的好天气，做好准备。

sentences.en: The next thing I heard was from a city official who confirmed the same thing that there was going to be announcements soon.
sentences.zh: 接下来我听到的是一位市政府官员证实了同样的事情，即很快会有宣布。

sentences.en: And we started hearing that a possible time was going to be one o'clock, maybe two o'clock, and possibly that it was
sentences.zh: 我们开始听说可能的时间是下午一点，也许是两点，而且可能

sentences.en: going to be in Frankfurt, which is an hour away from where I am now in Louisville.
sentences.zh: 是在法兰克福，距离我现在所在的路易斯维尔有一个小时的路程。

sentences.en: And it wasn't until
sentences.zh: 直到
上午11点40分

sentences.en: that I got an email from the attorney general's office saying the announcement is going to be at 1.30.
sentences.zh: 我才收到总检察长办公室的电子邮件，说宣布时间定在1点30分。

sentences.en: So I jumped in a car and raced to this place.
sentences.zh: 所以我跳上车，飞奔到那个地方。

sentences.en: It was like 15 minutes, almost an hour away.
sentences.zh: 大约15分钟，几乎要一个小时的路程。

sentences.en: And I almost missed the cutoff.
sentences.zh: 我差点错过了截止时间。

sentences.en: I mean, I literally got in my car the second I got the announcement and I almost didn't make it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我收到通知的那一刻就上了车，差点没赶上。

sentences.en: When I got to Frankfurt, we found the capital had again been locked down.
sentences.zh: 当我到达法兰克福时，发现首府再次被封锁了。

sentences.en: There were several city blocks that had police tape across them.
sentences.zh: 有几个街区拉起了警察警戒线。

sentences.en: Police officers directed me to where the media parking was.
sentences.zh: 警察指引我前往媒体停车区。

sentences.en: And then I entered the building where this announcement was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 然后我进入了将要举行这次宣布的大楼。

sentences.en: Once I got inside, there was a man who checked my bag.
sentences.zh: 进去后，有一个人检查了我的包。

sentences.en: Then they asked me to put my bag on the floor.
sentences.zh: 然后他们让我把包放在地上。

sentences.en: There was a dog with a handler that came and sniffed my bag.
sentences.zh: 有一只警犬和训导员过来嗅了我的包。

sentences.en: And then a second person took apart my bag and looked inside.
sentences.zh: 然后第二个人把我的包打开检查了里面。

sentences.en: And only at that point did they give me a badge and did I go all the way in.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，他们才给了我一个证件，我才得以进入里面。

sentences.en: The chairs were spaced more than six feet apart.
sentences.zh: 椅子之间的距离超过六英尺。

sentences.en: It was a very spacious area because of COVID.
sentences.zh: 由于新冠疫情，这是一个非常宽敞的区域。

sentences.en: We were all waiting quietly.
sentences.zh: 我们都在安静地等待。

sentences.en: And sometime after 1.30 p.m., the attorney general,
sentences.zh: 下午1点30分过后不久，总检察长，

sentences.en: Daniel Cameron, stepped onto this makeshift stage.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·卡梅伦，走上了这个临时搭建的舞台。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家今天参加。

sentences.en: And began addressing the reporters.
sentences.zh: 并开始向记者发表讲话。

sentences.en: The decision before my office as the special prosecutor in this case was not to decide if the loss of Ms. Taylor's life was a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 作为本案的特别检察官，我办公室面临的决定不是判断泰勒女士生命的逝去是否是一场悲剧。

sentences.en: The answer to that question is unequivocally yes.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的答案毫无疑问是肯定的。

sentences.en: And he described the death of Breonna Taylor as a tragedy and then went on to explain exactly what the legal experts I had spoken to had said.
sentences.zh: 他将布伦娜·泰勒的死亡描述为一场悲剧，然后继续解释了我之前采访过的法律专家所说的话。

sentences.en: In the early morning hours of March 13th, officers from LMPD executed a search warrant at 3003
sentences.zh: 3月13日凌晨，路易斯维尔大都会警察局（LMPD）的警官在3003号

sentences.en: Springfield Drive, apartment 4.
sentences.zh: 斯普林菲尔德大道4号公寓执行搜查令。

sentences.en: This was Ms. Breonna Taylor's residence.
sentences.zh: 这是布伦娜·泰勒女士的住所。

sentences.en: There were three officers who discharged their weapons on the night of March 13th.
sentences.zh: 3月13日晚，有三名警官开了枪。

sentences.en: These three officers were sent to Breonna Taylor's apartment with a legal warrant that had been signed by a magistrate the day before.
sentences.zh: 这三名警官带着前一天由地方法官签署的合法搜查令被派往布伦娜·泰勒的公寓。

sentences.en: These were not rogue cops that just broke into somebody's house.
sentences.zh: 他们不是闯入别人家里的流氓警察。

sentences.en: They had a legal document allowing them to go there.
sentences.zh: 他们有允许他们去那里的法律文件。

sentences.en: Sergeant Mattingly and Detectives Cosgrove and Hankinson had no known involvement in the preceding investigation or obtainment of the search warrant.
sentences.zh: 马廷利警长和科斯格罗夫及汉金森探员没有参与之前的调查或搜查令的获取。

sentences.en: They were called into duty as extra personnel to effectuate the service of the search warrant.
sentences.zh: 他们作为额外人员被派去执行搜查令。

sentences.en: They showed up at her apartment sometime after 1240 a.m.
sentences.zh: 他们在凌晨12点40分之后出现在她的公寓，

sentences.en: and they began loudly knocking at her door.
sentences.zh: 并开始大声敲门。

sentences.en: This is something that we know from our own reporting because Kenny Walker, Breonna Taylor's boyfriend, confirmed hearing the knocking.
sentences.zh: 这是我们从自己的报道中得知的，因为布伦娜·泰勒的男友肯尼·沃克证实听到了敲门声。

sentences.en: The attorney general went on to say that they had witnesses that said that they heard the police both knock and announce themselves.
sentences.zh: 总检察长接着说，他们有证人表示听到警察既敲门又表明了身份。

sentences.en: When officers were unable to get anyone to answer or open the door to apartment four, the decision was made to breach the door.
sentences.zh: 当警官无法让任何人应答或打开4号公寓的门时，他们决定破门而入。

sentences.en: As soon as they went in, they were met with gunfire from Breonna Taylor's boyfriend, who had not heard them announce themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们刚进去，就遭到了布伦娜·泰勒男友的枪击，他并没有听到他们表明身份。

sentences.en: Mr. Walker admitted that he fired one shot and was the first to shoot.
sentences.zh: 沃克先生承认他开了一枪，并且是第一个开枪的人。

sentences.en: The two officers who opened fire first, John Mattingly and Miles Cosgrove, were in the hallway
sentences.zh: 首先开火的两名警官，约翰·马廷利和迈尔斯·科斯格罗夫，当时在走廊里，

sentences.en: directly facing Breonna Taylor and her boyfriend, and they returned fire in the direction in which they had been fired upon from.
sentences.zh: 正对着布伦娜·泰勒和她的男友，他们向遭到射击的方向进行了还击。

sentences.en: Sergeant Mattingly saw the man's gun fire, heard a boom, and immediately knew he was shot as a result of feeling heat in his upper thigh.
sentences.zh: 马廷利警长看到那个男人的枪开了火，听到一声巨响，并因大腿上部感到灼热而立即知道自己中弹了。

sentences.en: So he explained to us that because of the Kentucky Statute on Self-Defense...
sentences.zh: 所以他向我们解释说，由于肯塔基州的自卫法规……

sentences.en: While there are six possible homicide charges under Kentucky law, these charges are not applicable
sentences.zh: 虽然肯塔基州法律下有六种可能的杀人罪指控，但这些指控并不适用于

sentences.en: to the facts before us because our investigation showed and the grand jury agreed that Mattingly
sentences.zh: 我们面前的事实，因为我们的调查显示，大陪审团也同意，马廷利

sentences.en: and Cosgrove were justified in the return of deadly fire after having been fired upon by Kenneth Walker.
sentences.zh: 和科斯格罗夫在遭到肯尼思·沃克射击后进行致命还击是正当的。

sentences.en: He explained that these officers were justified in shooting back.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，这些警官开枪还击是正当的。

sentences.en: This justification bars us from pursuing criminal charges in Ms. Breonna Taylor's death.
sentences.zh: 这种正当性阻止了我们对布伦娜·泰勒女士的死亡提起刑事指控。

sentences.en: There was another officer, Brett Hankinson, a detective.
sentences.zh: 还有另一名警官，布雷特·汉金森，一名探员。

sentences.en: He was also in this formation by the door.
sentences.zh: 他也在这扇门边的队形中。

sentences.en: But when the shooting began, he did something that to this day remains inexplicable, inexplicable, and that is that he spun around and he ran outside into the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 但当枪声响起时，他做了一件至今仍无法解释的事情，那就是他转身跑到了外面的停车场。

sentences.en: And from there, he began shooting blindly and erratically into the sliding glass door of her patio and into the window of one of her bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他开始盲目且杂乱地向她露台的推拉门和其中一间卧室的窗户开枪。

sentences.en: And he did this even though both of those openings were covered with blinds, so he did not have a line and sight inside.
sentences.zh: 尽管这两个开口都拉着百叶窗，他并没有看到里面的视线，但他还是这么做了。

sentences.en: We know that his bullets traveled through her living room, her kitchen, and clear through to the apartment
sentences.zh: 我们知道他的子弹穿过了她的客厅、厨房，一直穿到了后面

sentences.en: in the back where there was a couple, a pregnant woman and her husband, and their five-year-old child who were asleep.
sentences.zh: 的公寓，那里有一对夫妇、一名孕妇和她的丈夫，以及他们五岁的孩子正在睡觉。

sentences.en: After hearing the evidence from our team of prosecutors, the grand jury...
sentences.zh: 在听取了我们检察官团队提供的证据后，大陪审团……

sentences.en: This is when the Attorney General then explained that that officer was going to be charged with wanton endangerment.
sentences.zh: 这时总检察长解释说，那名警官将被控肆意危害他人安全罪。

sentences.en: For wantonly placing the three individuals in apartment three in danger of serious physical injury or death.
sentences.zh: 因为他肆意将3号公寓的三个人置于严重身体伤害或死亡的危险之中。

sentences.en: This is a lower-class felony, one for which you can get up to five years per count.
sentences.zh: 这是一项低级重罪，每项罪名最高可判处五年监禁。

sentences.en: And he was being charged with three counts because of the fact that his bullets traveled into the apartment behind Breonna Taylor's where there was the couple and their child.
sentences.zh: 他被控三项罪名，因为他的子弹射入了布伦娜·泰勒公寓后面的公寓，那里住着那对夫妇和他们的孩子。

sentences.en: Crucially, he explained something that we did not know up to this point.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，他解释了一些我们之前不知道的事情。

sentences.en: There is no conclusive evidence that any bullets fired from Detective Hankinson's weapon struck
sentences.zh: 没有确凿证据表明汉金森探员武器射出的任何子弹击中了

sentences.en: Ms. Taylor.
sentences.zh: 泰勒女士。

sentences.en: He said that Brett Hankinson's bullets did not touch Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 他说布雷特·汉金森的子弹没有碰到布伦娜·泰勒。

sentences.en: The person whose shots killed her was a detective named Miles Cosgrove, who was in the hallway of her apartment.
sentences.zh: 导致她死亡的枪击者是一名名叫迈尔斯·科斯格罗夫的探员，他当时就在她公寓的走廊里。

sentences.en: And this is according to the ballistics analysis that was done by the FBI at their lab in Quantico.
sentences.zh: 这是根据联邦调查局在匡提科实验室所做的弹道分析得出的结论。

sentences.en: Rukmi, just to summarize, during this news conference, the Attorney General said that charges will be brought against the one officer whose gunshots never struck Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，总结一下，在这次新闻发布会上，总检察长说将对那名从未击中布伦娜·泰勒的警官提起指控。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in the case of the two officers who did shoot Breonna Taylor, neither of them will be charged.
sentences.zh: 而在那两名确实射杀了布伦娜·泰勒的警官案件中，他们都不会被起诉。

sentences.en: You know, we had anticipated that this was most likely going to be the result that would occur.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们之前预料到这很可能是最终结果。

sentences.en: But it was clear from the way that the Attorney General presented this information that he had himself agonized over it and that he knew that this was going to disappoint people.
sentences.zh: 但从总检察长陈述这些信息的方式可以清楚地看出，他自己也为此感到痛苦，并且知道这会让人们失望。

sentences.en: He said at one point in the press conference, this is a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 他在新闻发布会上曾说，这是一场悲剧。

sentences.en: And sometimes the law, the criminal law, is not adequate to respond to a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 有时法律，刑事法律，不足以应对一场悲剧。

sentences.en: And then he went on, Detective Cosgrove and Sergeant Mattingly were justified in returning fire because they were fired upon.
sentences.zh: 然后他继续说，科斯格罗夫探员和马廷利警长在遭到射击后进行还击是正当的。

sentences.en: I know that not everyone will be satisfied with the charges we've reported today.
sentences.zh: 我知道并不是每个人都会对我们今天报告的指控感到满意。

sentences.en: My team set out to investigate the circumstances surrounding Ms. Taylor's death.
sentences.zh: 我的团队着手调查泰勒女士死亡前后的情况。

sentences.en: We did it with a singular goal in mind, pursuing the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们怀着一个单一的目标，那就是追求真相。

sentences.en: Kentuckians deserve no less.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州人民理应得到真相。

sentences.en: The city of Louisville deserves no less.
sentences.zh: 路易斯维尔市理应得到真相。

sentences.en: Intercommunity, I actually watched that news conference.
sentences.zh: Intercommunity，我确实看了那场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: And what I heard him say next was basically that the people of Louisville, who he knew were going to be upset by what he said and by what you heard,
sentences.zh: 我听他接下来所说的话，基本意思是路易斯维尔的人民——他知道这些人会对他的话以及你们所听到的内容感到不安，

sentences.en: because you were in the room, and he basically presented them with a choice.
sentences.zh: 因为你们当时就在现场——他基本上给了他们一个选择。

sentences.en: You know, will you accept this, even though you may not like it?
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使你不喜欢，你愿意接受这个结果吗？

sentences.en: Or will you react with rage and even with violence?
sentences.zh: 还是你会以愤怒甚至暴力来回应？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One of the quotes that I wrote down in my notebook was, if we simply act on outrage, there is no justice.
sentences.zh: 我在笔记本上记下的一句话是：如果我们仅仅出于愤怒而行动，那就没有正义可言。

sentences.en: Mob justice is not justice.
sentences.zh: 暴民的正义不是正义。

sentences.en: Justice sought by violence is not justice.
sentences.zh: 通过暴力寻求的正义不是正义。

sentences.en: It just becomes revenge.
sentences.zh: 那只会变成复仇。

sentences.en: Our reaction to truth today says what kind of society we are.
sentences.zh: 今天我们对真相的反应，决定了我们是一个什么样的社会。

sentences.en: Do we really want the truth, or do we want a truth that fits our narrative?
sentences.zh: 我们是真的想要真相，还是只想要一个符合我们叙事的真相？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《纽约时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So as this press conference is coming to an end, I'm seeing a WhatsApp channel of my colleagues who are back in Louisville.
sentences.zh: 就在新闻发布会即将结束时，我看到了回到路易斯维尔的同事们在WhatsApp频道里的消息。

sentences.en: I'm with The New York Times newspaper, man.
sentences.zh: 伙计，我是《纽约时报》的记者。

sentences.en: What do you think about...
sentences.zh: 你觉得……

sentences.en: You can't hear all that noise, man.
sentences.zh: 伙计，你听不到那些噪音。

sentences.en: You know, look what's happening.
sentences.zh: 你知道，看看正在发生什么。

sentences.en: You know it ain't right, man.
sentences.zh: 你知道这不对劲，伙计。

sentences.en: My colleague John Eligo.
sentences.zh: 我的同事约翰·埃利戈。

sentences.en: How do you feel about the decision there?
sentences.zh: 你对那个决定有什么看法？

sentences.en: How do I feel?
sentences.zh: 我有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's not right, man.
sentences.zh: 这不对劲，伙计。

sentences.en: My colleague Maliki Brown.
sentences.zh: 我的同事马利基·布朗。

sentences.en: My colleague Alexandra Garcia.
sentences.zh: 我的同事亚历山德拉·加西亚。

sentences.en: They need to be held accountable, but the whole damn system needs to be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 他们需要被追究责任，但整个该死的系统都需要被追究责任。

sentences.en: They have fanned out across Louisville.
sentences.zh: 他们已经分散到路易斯维尔各处。

sentences.en: They're in the square.
sentences.zh: 他们在广场上。

sentences.en: They're in the areas where the protesters are.
sentences.zh: 他们在抗议者所在的区域。

sentences.en: You cannot do your job!
sentences.zh: 你们根本无法工作！

sentences.en: No one has been held accountable.
sentences.zh: 没有人被追究责任。

sentences.en: No one has been held accountable.
sentences.zh: 没有人被追究责任。

sentences.en: This is injustice.
sentences.zh: 这是不公。

sentences.en: And they're reporting that the protesters are sobbing.
sentences.zh: 他们报道说抗议者们正在啜泣。

sentences.en: They murdered her!
sentences.zh: 他们谋杀了她！

sentences.en: They murdered her!
sentences.zh: 他们谋杀了她！

sentences.en: And that anger is mounting.
sentences.zh: 那种愤怒正在加剧。

sentences.en: Life is hurting, children.
sentences.zh: 生活在受苦，孩子们。

sentences.en: Life is hurting, children.
sentences.zh: 生活在受苦，孩子们。

sentences.en: No justice, no peace!
sentences.zh: 没有正义，就没有和平！

sentences.en: No justice, no peace!
sentences.zh: 没有正义，就没有和平！

sentences.en: No peace!
sentences.zh: 没有和平！

sentences.en: No peace, no peace, no peace, no peace, no peace!
sentences.zh: 没有和平，没有和平，没有和平，没有和平，没有和平！

sentences.en: And for the first part of the day...
sentences.zh: 在这一天的前半部分……

sentences.en: They were chanting.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在高呼口号。

sentences.en: They were walking.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在游行。

sentences.en: And then you started to see a couple of small disturbances.
sentences.zh: 然后你开始看到一些小规模的骚乱。

sentences.en: Maliki Brown was present at one area of the city where a protester that had a stick began smashing some windows and broke the windows of a business.
sentences.zh: 马利基·布朗当时在城市的一个区域，一名拿着棍子的抗议者开始打砸窗户，并砸碎了一家企业的窗户。

sentences.en: They kept marching and they kept on getting dispersed by the police in different areas.
sentences.zh: 他们继续游行，并不断在不同地区被警察驱散。

sentences.en: By late afternoon, I had made it back.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，我已经赶回来了。

sentences.en: And at this point, because what the city had done by creating all of these roadblocks and chain link fences and obstacles leading to the square,
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，因为市政府通过设置所有这些路障、铁丝网围栏和通往广场的障碍物所做的一切，

sentences.en: what that meant is that there wasn't a central point for them to meet.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们没有一个可以聚集的中心点。

sentences.en: So for much of the day, we were just kind of, you know, chasing the protesters.
sentences.zh: 所以那天大部分时间，我们只是在……你知道，追着抗议者跑。

sentences.en: They're here, they're there.
sentences.zh: 他们在这儿，他们在那儿。

sentences.en: We're going to this place.
sentences.zh: 我们要去这个地方。

sentences.en: We're going to that place.
sentences.zh: 我们要去那个地方。

sentences.en: This is the governmental police department.
sentences.zh: 这是政府警察局。

sentences.en: But if you're taking state law, this is an unlawful assembly.
sentences.zh: 但如果你按照州法律，这是一次非法集会。

sentences.en: And I can have a person so single to meet and be completely dispersed.
sentences.zh: 我可以让人单独会面并被彻底驱散。

sentences.en: Things intensified when the sun went down.
sentences.zh: 太阳下山后，局势升级了。

sentences.en: It was my colleague, Alexandra Garcia, who was filming at an area that was near an overpass when suddenly shots rang out.
sentences.zh: 我的同事亚历山德拉·加西亚当时正在立交桥附近的一个区域拍摄，突然响起了枪声。

sentences.en: Very quickly on social media, we started to see messages indicating that a police officer was down.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上很快就开始出现消息，称有一名警官倒下了。

sentences.en: I was actually with Sam Aguirre, who's Breonna Taylor's family's lawyer.
sentences.zh: 我当时其实和布雷奥娜·泰勒家人的律师萨姆·阿吉雷在一起。

sentences.en: He had just walked past me on the street.
sentences.zh: 他刚从街上走过我身边。

sentences.en: And we got as far as an area where we saw squad cars with flashing lights.
sentences.zh: 我们走到了一处能看到闪着警灯的警车的地方。

sentences.en: And it was at that point that I got an email from one of the police spokesmen who said that an officer had been shot.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我收到了一位警局发言人的邮件，说有一名警官中枪了。

sentences.en: In fact, more than one officer had been shot and that they would get back to us when they had more information.
sentences.zh: 事实上，不止一名警官中枪，他们会在有更多信息时回复我们。

sentences.en: It's past curfew.
sentences.zh: 已经过了宵禁时间。

sentences.en: We're walking in the streets of Louisville.
sentences.zh: 我们走在路易斯维尔的街头。

sentences.en: And we're following a protester right now who has gotten a GPS pin to the safe house, he says, where the protesters are gathering.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正跟着一名抗议者，他说他拿到了一个GPS定位，指向抗议者们正在聚集的安全屋。

sentences.en: It's now illegal for protesters and citizens to be outside.
sentences.zh: 现在抗议者和市民在外面活动是非法的。

sentences.en: Media are still allowed.
sentences.zh: 媒体仍然被允许活动。

sentences.en: But we're following this young man who is taking us to where the other protesters are.
sentences.zh: 但我们跟着这个年轻人，他正带我们去其他抗议者所在的地方。

sentences.en: At that point, we fell in with a group of protesters and they had shared that there was a safe house that they were going to.
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，我们加入了一群抗议者，他们分享说他们要去一个安全屋。

sentences.en: And so we followed them to the safe house.
sentences.zh: 于是我们跟着他们去了那个安全屋。

sentences.en: We're now at a church that has been opened by, apparently by the religious community.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在一座教堂里，显然是由宗教团体开放的。

sentences.en: And it's giving sanctuary to the protesters.
sentences.zh: 它正在为抗议者提供庇护。

sentences.en: The safe house was actually a church.
sentences.zh: 那个安全屋实际上是一座教堂。

sentences.en: It was the first Unitarian church.
sentences.zh: 那是第一联合教会。

sentences.en: And when I got there, I was able to speak to Reverend Laurie, the minister of that church.
sentences.zh: 当我到达那里时，我得以与该教堂的牧师劳里牧师交谈。

sentences.en: And she explained to us that they had researched the law, that it was private property,
sentences.zh: 她向我们解释说，他们研究过法律，这是私人财产，

sentences.en: and that they believed that the municipal ordinance stated that even when a curfew is in place, if you're leaving a religious service, you cannot be stopped.
sentences.zh: 而且他们认为市政条例规定，即使在宵禁期间，如果你刚参加完宗教仪式，你就不能被拦截。

sentences.en: When we got there, there was a guy called Father Tim who was giving out bottles of water to the protesters.
sentences.zh: 当我们到达那里时，有一个叫蒂姆神父的人正在给抗议者分发瓶装水。

sentences.en: They had snacks, granola bars, chips, everything.
sentences.zh: 他们有零食、燕麦棒、薯片，应有尽有。

sentences.en: And several dozen protesters arrived there, and they were using their megaphones in the sanctuary of the church,
sentences.zh: 几十名抗议者到达了那里，他们在教堂的圣所里使用扩音器，

sentences.en: giving the same speeches that they would have been giving out into the square.
sentences.zh: 发表着他们本应在广场上发表的同样的演讲。

sentences.en: After you heard the results of the investigation today, what's your reaction to that?
sentences.zh: 在听到今天的调查结果后，你对此有什么反应？

sentences.en: It made me want to come out and march for the first time.
sentences.zh: 这让我第一次想要出来参加游行。

sentences.en: They've been marching for 119 days.
sentences.zh: 他们已经游行了119天了。

sentences.en: This is the first time I felt like I should come.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次觉得我应该来。

sentences.en: Rukmini, I'm curious, as this scene is unfolding, if you're able to talk to people about their reaction to this grand jury decision, what they're saying about it.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，我很好奇，随着现场情况的发展，你是否能和人们谈谈他们对大陪审团决定的反应，以及他们对此的看法。

sentences.en: Well, in anticipation of the decision, I had a series of conversations with people in the square about what they expected.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在等待决定公布之前，我和广场上的人进行了一系列谈话，了解他们的预期。

sentences.en: And it was clear from speaking to some of them, there's a pretty big gap between the facts that I and other reporters have been able to uncover, in this case,
sentences.zh: 从与他们中的一些人交谈中可以清楚地看出，我和其他记者在这个案件中能够揭露的事实，与抗议者所相信的叙事和事件版本之间存在相当大的差距，

sentences.en: as we've dug and dug and dug, and the narrative and the version of events that the protesters believe.
sentences.zh: 随着我们不断深入挖掘，

sentences.en: The narrative that I was getting from the protesters, including things like that the police had gone to the wrong address, or that the police had no legal right to be there,
sentences.zh: 我从抗议者那里得到的叙事，包括警察去了错误的地址，或者警察没有法律权利出现在那里等内容，

sentences.en: these details don't line up with the actual facts of the case.
sentences.zh: 这些细节与案件的实际事实并不相符。

sentences.en: But this is a narrative that has become much bigger than the facts in this case.
sentences.zh: 但这已经成为一种比本案事实大得多的叙事。

sentences.en: And that's partly because both the city and the attorney general and other officials have been so stingy with releasing information on this case.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是因为市政府、总检察长和其他官员在发布此案信息时非常吝啬。

sentences.en: I mean, I came here in July, and it took every bit of reporting skill that I had to dislodge these hundreds and now thousands of pages of investigative files.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我七月份来到这里，我用尽了所有的报道技巧，才弄到了这成百上千，现在是数千页的调查档案。

sentences.en: It was really, really hard to get them, but it's only by getting all of this that I finally have this bigger picture that the attorney general talked about today.
sentences.zh: 获取这些资料真的非常非常困难，但只有通过获取所有这些资料，我才最终得到了总检察长今天所谈到的那个更大的图景。

sentences.en: The other issue is Breonna Taylor's name.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是布雷奥娜·泰勒的名字。

sentences.en: Her as a byword for racial injustice has spread from coast to coaSt.
sentences.zh: 她作为种族不公的代名词，已经传遍了全国各地。

sentences.en: She's become bigger than the facts of her case.
sentences.zh: 她已经变得比她案件的事实本身更重要了。

sentences.en: She's become a symbol of a young Black woman killed in a cruel and awful way by a group of white cops.
sentences.zh: 她已经成为一个象征，代表着一名年轻黑人女性被一群白人警察以残酷而可怕的方式杀害。

sentences.en: Rukmini, try to get some sleep, and thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，试着睡一会儿，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Take care, Michael.
sentences.zh: 保重，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The body of the late Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg was carried into the Great Hall of the Supreme Court building on Wednesday for the start of three days of public mourning for her death.
sentences.zh: 已故大法官鲁斯·巴德·金斯伯格的遗体于周三被抬入最高法院大楼的大厅，开始为期三天的公众哀悼活动。

sentences.en: It has been said that Ruth wanted to be an opera virtuoso, but became a rock star instead.
sentences.zh: 有人说鲁斯想成为一名歌剧名伶，但最终却成了摇滚巨星。

sentences.en: But she chose the law.
sentences.zh: 但她选择了法律。

sentences.en: During a short ceremony, the court's chief justice, John Roberts, remembered Ginsburg as a champion of equal justice.
sentences.zh: 在简短的仪式上，首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨缅怀了金斯伯格，称她是平等正义的捍卫者。

sentences.en: Her 483 majority, concurring, and dissenting opinions will steer the court for decades.
sentences.zh: 她撰写的483份多数意见书、协同意见书和异议意见书将在未来几十年里指引法院的方向。

sentences.en: Her voice in court and in our conference room was soft, but when she spoke, people listened.
sentences.zh: 她在法庭和会议室里的声音很轻柔，但当她发言时，人们都会倾听。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
